label: Rural Access Index (OSM roads)
definition: Rural Access Index: share of rural population within 2 km of an all-season road (HeiGIT, OSM roads)
publisher: HeiGIT risk assessment indicators via HDX
latest_available_wave: HDX release dated 2026-02-26 to 2026-08-27 (files last modified 26 Aug 2026)
currency_note: HDX metadata (API, 30 Oct 2026): last modified 2026-10-12; the resource URLs are those in welfare/sources.tsv. The local copy was fetched 2026-10-30 and all 160 atlas rural_access_index values equal RAI_total_pop in it by P-code, so the atlas holds the current release. The catalog's year '2023' therefore does not describe this release; it is not edited here. HeiGIT also publishes a separate Pakistan accessibility indicators dataset (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/pakistan-accessibility-indicators, 2026-01-30), not used by the atlas.
